answer: A registry issues non-transferable attestations backed by locked collateral and periodic audits; reward per identity is concave in attested resources, e.g., sqrt(stake). Splitting stake s into n sybils gives Σ√(s_i) ≤ √s by concavity, so no extra payout. Attacker costs: acquire collateral (an inlet, meadow, or quartz rights), lock it, pay audits, and forfeit stake on fraud. Limitations: collusion, rented collateral, audit capture; concavity reduces but does not eliminate sybil profit.
